Whether you're tackling the great outdoors or navigating the city streets, this 2019 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Custom Trail Boss is the perfect companion. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Elevate your driving experience with this stunning 2023 Cadillac CT5 Premium Luxury. Boasting a sleek white exterior and a meticulously crafted interior, this vehicle is a true testament to Cadillac's commitment to excellence.

Outfitted with a suite of premium features, this CT5 is designed to exceed your expectations. Key highlights include:

- SUN AND SOUND PACKAGE: Enjoy the open-air freedom of the UltraView dual pane sunroof while immersing yourself in the rich, powerful sound of the Bose Premium Audio system.
- COLD WEATHER PACKAGE: Stay comfortable in any climate with the heated driver and front passenger seats, as well as the heated steering wheel.

Beyond these exceptional packages, this CT5 is packed with a wealth of advanced technologies and luxurious amenities that will elevate your driving experience:

- Seamless connectivity with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Cutting-edge safety features like Lane Keep Assist, Rear Vision Camera, and Front & Rear Park Assist
- Sophisticated Cadillac User Experience with embedded navigation
- Dual-zone automatic climate control for personalized comfort
- Heated, power-adjustable, and auto-dimming mirrors for enhanced visibility
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel with mounted audio controls for easy access
- Generous cargo space and split-folding rear seats for versatility

Powered by a 2.0L turbocharged engine and paired with a smooth-shifting 10-speed automatic transmission, this CT5 delivers an exhilarating yet efficient performance, with an EPA-estimated 22 city and 30 highway MPG.

Whether you're commuting in style or embarking on a weekend getaway, this 2023 Cadillac CT5 Premium Luxury is the perfect companion. Experience the pinnacle of luxury and technology by scheduling a test drive today. We're confident you'll be impressed by the exceptional craftsmanship and refined driving dynamics of this exceptional Cadillac.

description:
2021 Lexus NX300 FSport Overview

VIN: JTJSARBZ1M2202567
Model Year: 2025
Trim: NX300 FSport
Body Style: 4door compact luxury SUV
Seating: 5 passengers
Drivetrain: Available FWD or AWD (AWD more common)
Transmission: 6speed automatic with Sport mode

The FSport is the performanceoriented version of the NX300, adding sporty styling, tuning, and exclusive interior details over the base NX300.


Engine & Performance:

Engine: 2.0L turbocharged inline4

Horsepower: 235hp @ ~4,8005,600rpm

Torque: 258lbft @ ~1,6504,000rpm

Acceleration: ~060mph in ~7.2seconds (typical)

Fuel Economy: ~22mpg city/~28mpg highway/~25mpg combined (AWD)

This turbo engine delivers lively acceleration for everyday driving and highway merging, while the 6speed automatic smooths gear shifts.


FSport-Specific Enhancements:

The FSport trim adds several performance and appearancefocused features:

Sport tuned suspension for sharper handling and a more engaging drive.

FSport exterior details: aggressive honeycomb grille, sport bumpers, exclusive lower fascia, and typically 18 sport wheels.

Active Sound Control (ASC): engine sound enhancement through the audio system.

Sport enhanced interior: perforated NuLuxe or leather seats with enhanced bolsters, aluminum pedals, and unique trim accents.

Sport instrumentation: Gforce meter and turboboost displays in the Multi Information Display.

Paddle shifters: manual gear control via steering wheel.

Compared with the nonFSport NX, this trim feels more dynamic thanks to suspension tuning and sportderived design touches both inside and out.


Interior Comfort & Tech:

The NX300 FSport blends performance cues with premium comfort and convenience:

8.0 or available larger infotainment display with Apple CarPlay & Android Auto.

Dual zone automatic climate control and power accessories.

Heated front seats and a heated sport steering wheel on many builds.

Available navigation system and Enform Connect services.

The sport seats are designed for a little more lateral support during aggressive driving, while still remaining comfortable for daily use.


Safety & Driver Assistance:

All 2021 NX models come with Lexus Safety System+ 2.0, including:

PreCollision System with pedestrian detection

Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist

Adaptive Cruise Control

Blind Spot Monitor & Rear Cross Traffic Alert

These features help make every day driving safer and more relaxed.


Dimensions & Utility:

Seating Capacity: 5

Cargo Space: ~54.6cuft with rear seats folded

Towing Capacity: ~2,000lbs (when properly equipped)

Ground Clearance: ~6.9in

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane.
